text:
Maya: Quick sync — mapping out the content hub + redirects work for the new benchmarks/benchmarks-webinar pages. Need owners and checklist.
Simon: I can own keyword mapping and schema snippets. Will start a sheet.
Zara: Thanks — we need webinar page schema (Event + VideoObject) and a clear hero keyword target: "LLM inference benchmarks" or similar.
Maya: Agreed on primary kw + a set of longtails. Simon — can you post the first draft of keyword clusters by EOD?
Simon: Yup. Draft will include seed keywords, intent (informational/comparative), and suggested url slugs.
Ethan: For internal linking, can we create a single hub page that links to: benchmarks overview, webinar replay, how-to guides, and model docs? Keeps authority concentrated.
Rob: FYI — when we do redirects, we should prefer 301s for permanent consolidations. Also need a redirect map file for nginx and Cloudflare rules.
Simon: Putting redirect candidates in the sheet. Example rule we’ll test: 
```
rewrite ^/old-benchmarks/(.*)$ /benchmarks/$1 permanent;
```
Maya: Nice. Also want canonical tags on paginated lists and parameter-free analytics URLs.
Zara: Webinar page schema draft: 
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference Benchmarks webinar","startDate":"2026-04-14T16:00:00-07:00","eventStatus":"https://schema.org/EventScheduled","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.com/webinars/benchmarks"},"performer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}}
```
Simon: We'll also include VideoObject for the replay and speakable/spec markups for key quotes.
Ethan: On internal linking heuristics: hero -> cluster -> leaf. Use breadcrumb JSON-LD and text links in first two paragraphs. Avoid burying links in footer only.
Rob: Testing plan: push redirects to staging, smoke test 100 sample old URLs, run Screaming Frog crawl, then promote. I can schedule the deploy window.
Maya: Owners + deadlines? Simon = keyword & schema (Wed), Rob = redirect map + staging deploy (Thu), Ethan = link graph + breadcrumb snippets (Wed), Zara = webinar schema + copy (Tue). I'll consolidate in the project board.
Simon: Also flagging potential cannibalization between /blog/ and /benchmarks/. Will add recommended redirects and canonical decisions.
Zara: SEO-bot: sitemap updated for /benchmarks and /webinar once staging is green :robot_face:
SEO-bot: sitemap: /benchmarks, /benchmarks/overview, /webinars/benchmarks-replay added.
Maya: Perfect. Last bit — analytics: tag redirect sources with utm_source=old-url so we can attribute lost vs retained traffic.
Rob: Good call. We'll add UTM param rewrite in the staging rule set for testing.
Ethan: I'll draft the internal-linking map (CSV) and drop it here when ready.
Maya: Thanks team — will follow up with the board links and the doc that ties keywords to page templates. :thumbsup:
